workflow.authority_boundaries_excerpt:
# Managed Repository Workflow

This package-owned workflow supplements the applicable repository `AGENTS.md` files. Repository instructions, explicit user authority, repository documents, code, tests, runtime evidence, and Git history remain the system of record. Templates provide process scaffolding only; they cannot create product policy, validation authority, or completion evidence.

Consumer repositories do not need `repository-harness` installed. This package neither invokes nor installs it.

## Select The Work Shape

### Read-only

Questions, explanations, reviews, diagnoses, plans, proposals, and status checks inspect only what the answer needs. They create no repository documents and perform no repository mutation.

### Bounded mutation

A small coherent change that can finish in one agent run and can safely resume from its diff uses ephemeral planning. It creates no lifecycle do

prior_audits.note: Prior audits focused on extension logic/CI; this audit focuses on skills+workflow packaging completeness

skill_pack_completeness.instructions: Score completeness and quality of the 11 packaged Pi skills (frontmatter, companions, UPSTREAM, README alignment, authority contracts, Pi loadability).
criteria: 0 broken — missing skills, broken frontmatter, package/README mismatch, or unloadable
1 prototype — skills present but thin contracts, inconsistent metadata, weak companions/docs
2 RC solid — eleven skills consistent with pi.skills + README + tests; clear authority; minor polish gaps OK
3 production-complete — exemplary skill pack with no meaningful packaging/discoverability/contract gaps

workflow_completeness.instructions: Score WORKFLOW.md + templates + manifest integrity as the managed repository workflow contract.
criteria: 0 broken — missing/corrupt workflow assets or checksum mismatch
1 prototype — docs exist but authority/onboarding/validation contracts incomplete or ambiguous
2 RC solid — clear work shapes, preparation, document authority, validation/completion, recovery; hashes match
3 production-complete — exhaustive operator-ready workflow with no material ambiguity

skill_workflow_alignment_with_extension.instructions: Score how well skills + WORKFLOW align with Continuity/managed-workflow extension contracts (prepare/finalize/bind, read-only gates, memory non-authority, no competing truth).
criteria: 0 contradicted — skills/workflow conflict with extension tools or safety model
1 partial — mostly aligned but important tool/authority gaps or contradictions
2 RC solid — consistent prepare/finalize/plan authority; minor wording gaps OK
3 exemplary — skills and workflow perfectly encode extension contracts

install_discoverability.instructions: Score how discoverable skills+workflow are after pi install (package files, README, skills/README, pi.skills, validators/tests).
criteria: 0 undiscoverable — not packaged or undocumented
1 weak — packaged but hard to find or incomplete install docs
2 good RC — clear README/skills index and packaged correctly; minor doc gaps OK
3 excellent — install-to-use path crystal clear with proof

docs_clarity.instructions: Score clarity of skills README, UPSTREAM, WORKFLOW.md, and template guidance for agents and humans.
criteria: 0 confusing/contradictory
1 usable but uneven
2 clear RC — authority boundaries and steps readable
3 exemplary documentation

ready_to_ship_skills_workflow.instructions: Is the skills+workflow pack ready to ship/update on PR #2 for human review as RC (not claiming production-complete)? True if materially complete and safe; false if blocking gaps remain.

criteria.true: Ready for PR review as RC skills+workflow
criteria.false: Blocking gaps remain before updating PR

biggest_gap.instructions: Single biggest gap limiting skills+workflow completeness right now.

criteria.missing_tests_validators: Insufficient tests/validators for skill packaging or workflow inventory
criteria.install_docs_discoverability: Hard to discover skills/workflow after install from main README/docs
